default_subtype.purpose: The approval subtype to use unless a more appropriate one is selected.

enum_descriptions.recommended: A recommendation that is not yet a formal sign-off.
enum_descriptions.endorsed: A stronger endorsement, short of final approval.

subtype_policy.purpose: Whether generation may choose the approval subtype for this block.

enum_descriptions.ai_selectable: Generation may choose the approval subtype from the configured subtypes.

missing_content_behavior.purpose: What to do when no approval content is generated for this block.

enum_descriptions.leave_as_is: Keep an unselected/empty approval block unchanged rather than removing it.

approval_block_subtypes.purpose: The display label to render for each approval subtype.

expected_content_schema.description: Expected AI output for an approval block. null leaves the block unchanged; an object selects an approval subtype and fills the approver name and role.
